courses.title: NEET Integrated Classroom Program
courses.details:
Integrated classroom coaching for Class 11th and 12th medical aspirants. The program covers Physics, Chemistry, and Biology for NEET alongside complete school board syllabus (CBSE, ICSE, and State Boards).

Preparation includes daily concept classes, NCERT line-by-line coverage, chapter-wise subjective tests for board exams, and weekly objective mock tests for NEET practice. Dedicated doubt-clearing sessions are conducted to resolve individual queries and strengthen problem-solving speed.
courses.schedule: Mon - Sat (3 hrs) • Sun - Test (3 hrs)

courses.details:
Targeted classroom coaching for Class 11th and 12th engineering aspirants. The curriculum covers Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics for JEE Main and JEE Advanced alongside board syllabus requirements.

Teaching focuses on conceptual problem-solving, stepwise numerical practice, and systematic revision. Assessment includes regular chapter-end subjective tests for board exams, objective test series on JEE patterns, and comprehensive doubt-solving support.
courses.schedule: Mon - Sat (3 hrs) • Sun - Test (3 hrs)
courses.title: IIT-JEE Entrance & Board Preparation

courses.details:
Foundation coaching for Class 9th and 10th students in Science and Mathematics. Designed to build strong fundamentals for school board examinations (CBSE, ICSE, and HBSE) while laying the groundwork for NTSE, Olympiads, and future competitive exams.

The batch includes structured concept explanation, NCERT-based question practice, regular chapter tests, and personalized academic guidance.

courses.schedule: Mon - Sat (2 hrs) • Sun - Test (1 hour)
